Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 1 attempted to move
into the adjacent lane. While changing lanes, the left side of Driver 1's vehicle made contact with the right rear quarter
panel of Driver 2's vehicle, which was positioned slightly ahead and to the left. Driver 2 confirmed at the scene that
the collision occurred in the manner described, and two independent witnesses provided consistent statements that
they saw the lane change and the resulting contact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's
vehicle and was present throughout the incident, as confirmed by both witnesses and by my own observation at the
scene. Photographs taken at the scene show scraping and displaced paneling on the left side of Driver 1's vehicle
and matching damage to the right rear of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with a sideswipe impact. Driver 1 reported pain
in the lower back immediately following the collision, which is a common complaint in side-impact events of this kind.
Driver 1 stated that there was no prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was noted during the inspection.
Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
